import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import observe_output as O
chk = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/validate_verdict.py", "--check-schema", "schemas/worker-output.schema.json"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert chk.returncode == 0, chk.stderr
ok = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/validate_verdict.py", "schemas/worker-output.schema.json", "tests/fixtures/verdicts/good-worker-output.json"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert ok.returncode == 0, ok.stderr
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".json") as f:
    json.dump({"self_reported_model": {"value": "gpt-5.6-luna", "source": "observed"}, "summary": "done", "checks": []}, f); f.flush()
    bad = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/validate_verdict.py", "schemas/worker-output.schema.json", f.name], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert bad.returncode == 1, bad.stdout
req = {"value": "claude-haiku-5-5", "source": "configured"}
obs_diff = {"value": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "source": "observed"}
unk = {"value": None, "source": "unknown"}
sr = {"value": "gpt-5.6-luna", "source": "self_reported"}
r1 = O.resolve_model_identity(req, obs_diff, unk)
assert r1["drift"] is True and r1["attributed_model"] == "claude-sonnet-5-5" and r1["flags"] == ["model_drift"], r1
r2 = O.resolve_model_identity(req, unk, sr)
assert r2["drift"] is False and r2["attributed_model"] == "gpt-5.6-luna" and r2["confidence"] == "low" and r2["routing_weight"] == 0.5 and r2["flags"] == ["low_confidence_model"], r2
r3 = O.resolve_model_identity(req, unk, unk)
assert r3["drift"] is False and r3["confidence"] == "unknown" and r3["routing_weight"] == 0.25 and r3["flags"] == [], r3
r4 = O.resolve_model_identity(req, {"value": "claude-haiku-5-5", "source": "observed"}, sr)
assert r4["drift"] is False and r4["self_reported_mismatch"] is True and r4["attributed_model"] == "claude-haiku-5-5" and r4["flags"] == [], r4
print("ok")
